lede: SEEQ makes clear protein: a whey protein isolate powder that mixes into a thin, fruit-flavored drink instead of a milky shake. It sells tubs and single-serve packets on its own store at seeqsupply.com. Here's what the ratings say, what the label lists, what it costs and what the return rules are.

parts: SEEQ is a real US brand from Minneapolis with thousands of reviews on its own store, 4.7 to 4.8 out of 5 per flavor. It costs $2.45 a serving for a tub, or less with the code or a subscription. Two things to know: everything is final sale, and it has almost no independent reviews on Trustpilot yet.

SEEQ sells one product in several flavors: Clear Protein in Blue Razz Freeze, Mango Pineapple, Strawberry Lemonade, Fruit Punch and a limited Juicy Peach, at $54 for a 22-serving tub. A $49 variety pack holds 18 single-serve packets in three flavors.

The product page lists 22 g of protein, 100 calories, 0 g sugar and 0 g lactose per serving, made with whey protein isolate and sweetened with monk fruit. Whey comes from milk; talk to a doctor first if you're pregnant or take medication.

figure.alt: The SEEQ Clear Protein variety pack

parts: The store's ratings are high and come from thousands of buyers, but they are shown by SEEQ itself. On Trustpilot there was a single review, so there isn't an independent rating to lean on yet.
The main thing that can disappoint is the final-sale rule: if you don't like a flavor, you can't send it back. The variety pack is the cheaper way to find out which one you like.

Yes, by what we could check. The store account lists Minneapolis, Minnesota, it publishes its shipping and return rules, and its products have thousands of ratings. People also search for SEEQ at Walmart and in Canada, but we only checked SEEQ's own store.

At $2.45 a serving for a tub, or $1.96 on subscription by the product page, SEEQ costs more than a basic whey powder and is in line with other clear whey isolates. You're paying for the light, juice-like drink rather than more protein per scoop.
Our [SEEQ discount code guide](saving-tips-seeq-discount-code.html) lists every way to pay less, with prices side by side.

parts: SEEQ suits people who find milky protein shakes heavy and want a fruit-flavored drink instead. It's a poor fit if you want the lowest price per gram of protein, or want to be able to return a tub.
